name: Dragon Poulerns
shortDescription: Metal dragon pauldrons based on a Prince Armory pattern and modified to incorporate throwing spikes at the shoulders.
description: The Dragon Pauldrons are based on a pattern owned by Prince Armory. I constructed all of the armor pieces from metal rather than using a mixed-material build.
I modified the shoulder design to incorporate throwing spikes, giving the pauldrons a distinct feature beyond the original pattern.
